scope: Read-only review of applyOpalReflection in src/components/Island3D.jsx against installed Three.js 0.187.0.
nativeIridescenceDecision: Disabled only on the shared ground/basin runtime material after alternating same-context feature tests found about 9% lower SwiftShader frame time and effectively equivalent default and +/-30-degree views; see opal-feature-cost.
mechanism: The onBeforeCompile hook tints reflectedLight.indirectDiffuse and reflectedLight.indirectSpecular using reflected world direction and a bounded fifth-power grazing term.
compatibilityEvidence: Installed meshphysical shader includes aomap_fragment after lighting evaluation and before reflected-light totals.
geometryNormal and geometryViewDir are defined in lights_fragment_begin.
Canonical material name SUP Opalescent ground matches the material-name guard.
Custom cache key is distinct and the previous onBeforeCompile callback is preserved.
portability: This shader extension and PMREM lighting setup are application code. They are not exported in island.glb or reproduced by the Blender preview. The standalone asset retains its native opaque metallic-roughness PBR, clearcoat and iridescence.
maintenance: Shader-chunk integration should be checked when upgrading Three.js. The present installed shader API matches the hook.
validationLimit: Static compatibility/opacity review; browser shader compilation, rendered appearance, interactions and performance are recorded by the browser QA agent.
